verdict.rationale: BUGBOT.md lets teams manually encode project-specific review guidelines that persist across PRs, and Bugbot reads existing PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback — but this is scoped to a single PR's context, not a persistent memory built automatically from past review decisions across PRs. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic learning/memory of past review outcomes across multiple PRs, evidence that team conventions are inferred rather than manually authored in BUGBOT.md.
